title: Explain my 3 campaigns (French)
message: Tu mexplqies les 3 campaingen cours ce quelles font

list_campaigns.note: A campaign is a sales funnel campaign: this is the full list. Its steps (sources, cold email, AI booking...) are parts of it, never campaigns: never count or name them as campaigns.

campaigns.name: Bliss
campaigns.spent: $10.06 spent today (cap reached: no new first touches until the next period)

get_offer_performance.omitted: Per-company list, per-day series and per-channel detail are left out to keep the chat small: the offer and campaign pages show them (open_page).

facts: Three campaigns: Bliss (finds prospects then cold emails them, max $10 a day, cap reached today at $10.06), Motivate (answers replies, up to $1 a day, $0 today), Moving (answers replies, no max budget so it does not run).
expect: Explains each campaign in one line in French, flags that Moving has no budget so it does not run, and ends on one next step (e.g. give Moving a budget).
prodReply:
**Bliss** (proactive) va chercher des prospects (Apollo, signaux d'achat, engagement LinkedIn) puis leur envoie des cold emails pour ouvrir la conversation. Max $10/jour, $10.06 dépensés aujourd'hui : le plafond est atteint, plus de nouveaux premiers contacts avant la prochaine période.

**Motivate** (réactive) prend le relais quand quelqu'un répond : l'IA propose et cale un rendez-vous. Budget jusqu'à $1/jour, $0 dépensé aujourd'hui.

**Moving** (réactive) rappelle instantanément par un appel IA la personne qui a répondu, pour l'amener à réserver un appel. Elle n'a pas de budget max : elle est donc non financée.
